title: Falsifying sign triple
statement: For a sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$ and a label $c\in\{0,1,2,3\}$, define a triple of signs whose first coordinate is $-b$ times the first coordinate of the even sign triple indexed by $c$, and whose other two coordinates agree with that even sign triple.
